p.s: A good advertisements has to make products seem much better than they really are because people has to be incouraged to buy that product.
Every day, we whatch on the television or see on the magazine a lot of surprising and miracolous products which seem to come from the space.
They offer to us a perfect body or a cleaned kitchen.
It 's important that a successful advertise would present better caratteristics than they have.
It 's true that in the world there 's a lot of people who is ready to buy the new product and strictly believe in the success of its effect.
The useful of the advertisement, wherever they are showed, owes its success to the "unability" of the population of the world to mark what could be good and true from what is an invention.
I think that a person in order to sale something could be ready to say the exact contrary of what that thing do.
I hate the numerous sales advertisements that appear on the television.
They only want cheat the people!
In Italy, we have a TV program which looks for, finds out and shows the most various cheating.
Very often, the people who are cheated are poor and with a low level of instruction; they have to earn for a living in hard way and very frequently they have to aswf for money.
On this money there 's a too big and uncorrect tax and they go on to ask for money to live.
But this is one of the awful cheating that scrupolousless people do.
Another one could be about astrologists who ask a lot of money for a lot of lyings.
But I think that the world could not change as it runs on this way since it exists, or better, since the human race exists.
